spans.s: Nikumbha^1, name of several Asuras. § 90 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2527 (son of Prahlāda).--§ 92 (do.): I, 65, 2534 (another, son of Danu).--§ 130 (do.): I, 67, 2662 (incarnate as king Devādhipa).--§ 246 (Sundopasundop.): I, 209, 7620 (Daityendraḥ, father of Sunda and Upasunda).
Nikumbha^3, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2558.
